newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-MOORER RETAINS TITLE ON A MAJORITY DECISION.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-MOORER RETAINS TITLE ON A MAJORITY DECISION.

text.p: Michael Moorer retained the International Boxing Federation heavyweight title with a plodding majority decision over obscure Vaughn Bean on Saturday.
Moorer escaped with a majority decision victory. Judge Bill Graham scored it 116-113, Jerry Roth 115-113 while Dave Moretti had it 114-114.
There were no knockdowns in the 12-round bout.
